title: Captain's Quarters Riverfront #3
description:
Beautiful Condo Downtown Riverfront- Walking distance from Broadway, Honky Tonk Central , LP Field, Bridgestone Arena, The Baseball Stadium, Restaurants, Music City Row, The Ryman, Top Golf and so much more! Free parking, wifi and HDTV. Lay by the pool or sit on the balcony and enjoy the beauty of the river. The condo is fully stocked with ammenities. Coffee maker, linens, full size bed and 2 single & a sofa sleeper in the common area. Join me! Stay at 1 of the best places in downtown Nashville!

Guest access
A code will be given before guest arrive to gain access to the condo!

Other things to note
Pool is temporarily closed due to the tornado in 2020. Will re-open July 1, 2021.
